articles.title: The Importance of the Battle of Savo Island
articles.summary: On August 9, 1942, an Allied fleet of 17 superior warships positioned near Guadalcanal prepared to defend against an approaching Japanese force. Despite possessing newer, larger, and better-equipped vessels, this engagement marked a critical early naval confrontation in the Pacific during World War II, crucial for control of the Solomon Islands. The ensuing battle tested naval strategy and vigilance.

articles.title: Guns, drones & algos: AI joins the fight on frontlines
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is profoundly transforming modern warfare, fundamentally reshaping how battles are fought and decided. This significant 'deep-tech shift' highlights AI's growing strategic importance in defence. For SSB aspirants, understanding AI's role in military advancements is crucial, as it directly impacts future defence strategies, operational capabilities, and technological readiness within the armed forces.

articles.title: Germany to despatch minesweeper for possible Hormuz mission
articles.summary: Germany is deploying a minesweeper to the Mediterranean, potentially for a mission in the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz. This move, announced by its defence ministry, signals a response to heightened geopolitical tensions, particularly concerning US-Iran dynamics. Such international deployments underscore efforts to ensure maritime security and freedom of navigation in critical global waterways.
